verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week while spend held steady.
narrative: This period you received 296 leads across Google Ads at a 28-day cost per lead of $2.02, but the most recent 7 days tell a harder story — leads fell 42% week-over-week while spend dropped only 4%, pushing the short-term cost per lead up roughly 68%. The drop sharpened in the final three days of the window, with November 15 reporting zero leads, which points to a tracking or conversion issue rather than a pure performance collapse. At the same time, website sessions rose nearly 9% week-over-week, meaning traffic is arriving but not being captured — conversion tracking is being investigated and repaired now. Expect the 28-day cost per lead to normalize once the tracking gap is resolved and confirmed data resumes flowing.
